description: Convert all HCC schools to neighborhood schools (user): the HCC program dissolves district-wide. Pure pathway sites (Cascadia, Decatur) lose their entire draw - HC students return to their home areas and redistribute across the remaining option and neighborhood schools by each area's observed choice mix; mixed sites (Thurgood Marshall, the 4 MS pathway sites) lose just their HC cohort the same way. Gifted yellow-bus transportation ends entirely.

ops.comment: HCC program ends; HC students redistribute to their areas' choice mix
